title: Along Came a Spider
author: James Patterson
summary: A Washington, D.C. detective who is also a psychologist is drawn into the case of two children snatched from an exclusive school. The kidnapper is careful, clever and appears to enjoy the game.
readIf: you like very short chapters and a quick, twisty chase between a cop and a villain.
skipIf: you want slow, well-drawn characters or to avoid stories about kidnapped children.

pairings.reason: Another thriller built around a clever killer and a brilliant, unlikely detective.
A more psychological, better-written look at a detective chasing a disturbed mind.
